stem: A shipment of growing media arrives with torn outer bags and visible moisture damage. What is the best technician action?
choices: Use the media first so it does not go to waste
Segregate the affected material, document the condition, and follow intake disposition procedure
Mix the damaged bags with intact stock
Store the shipment in propagation until someone notices a problem
rationale: Damaged incoming material may present contamination or quality risk and should be segregated and evaluated before use.
